{{Current events|year=2018|month=10|day=10|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Disasters and accidents
*At least 51 people are killed when a bus traveling from the [[Kenya]]n capital [[Nairobi]] to [[Kisumu]] veers off the road and overturns. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-45807969 (BBC)]
*At least 10 people have died in [[flash flood]]ing on the [[Spain|Spanish]] island of [[Mallorca|Majorca]]. A child is missing. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-45807978 (BBC)]
*Four people are killed and 20 others are injured when an apartment building collapses in [[Manama]], [[Bahrain]]. [http://gulfbusiness.com/least-four-killed-building-collapses-bahrain/ (Gulf Business)]
*[[2018 Atlantic hurricane season]]
**[[Hurricane Michael]] strengthens to a "potentially catastrophic" [[list of Category 4 Atlantic hurricanes|Category 4]] hurricane and makes landfall on the [[Florida Panhandle]]. [https://www.npr.org/2018/10/10/656052881/hurricane-michael-an-extremely-dangerous-category-4-storm-heads-toward-florida (NPR)] [http://fortune.com/2018/10/10/hurricane-michael-florida-landfall/ (Fortune)]

;International relations
*The [[Media of Turkey|Turkish newspaper]] ''[[Sabah (newspaper)|Sabah]]'' names the 15-member [[Saudi Arabia]]n intelligence team allegedly involved in the disappearance of Saudi journalist [[Jamal Khashoggi]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-saudi-politics-dissident-turkey/turkish-newspaper-names-15-saudis-in-khashoggi-case-idUSKCN1MK0J0?feedType=RSS&feedName=worldNews (Reuters)]

;Law and crime
*[[Capital punishment in Bangladesh]], [[Terrorism in Bangladesh]]
**A [[Dhaka]] court sentences 19 people to death, including two former ministers, and sentences [[Bangladesh Nationalist Party]] acting chairman [[Tarique Rahman]] to life imprisonment over a [[2004 Dhaka grenade attack|2004 attack]] on [[Prime Minister of Bangladesh|Prime Minister]] [[Sheikh Hasina]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2018/10/bangladesh-court-sentences-19-death-2004-attack-case-181009111251124.html (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-bangladesh-politics-court/bangladeshs-de-facto-opposition-chief-gets-life-sentence-ahead-of-national-vote-idUSKCN1MK0ME (Reuters)]
